words.definition_en: to change your behaviour or a method so that it suits new conditions
words.example: Small businesses must adapt to changes in demand.
words.example_zh: 小企业必须适应需求的变化。
common_errors: 表示“适应”时使用 adapt to，不使用 adapt with。
words.usage: 谈论应对环境、需求或制度变化。
words.source: Original example for personal import; check before adapting.

words.definition_en: information kept so that it can be used later
words.example: The clinic keeps a record of each visit.
words.example_zh: 诊所保存每次就诊的记录。

words.definition_en: to store information or sound so that it can be used later
words.example: The researchers record the temperature every hour.
words.example_zh: 研究人员每小时记录一次温度。
